clinician.final_diagnosis: metastatic breast mucinous adenocarcinoma (MAC) to the mandibular gingiva
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 58-year-old female presented with a nonhealing post-extraction wound of the mandibular gingiva three months after tooth extraction, with swelling and gingival vegetation. Biopsy of the gingival lesion revealed metastatic mucinous adenocarcinoma characterized by nests of cells in mucin lakes. Immunohistochemistry showed strong estrogen and progesterone receptor positivity, GATA-3 positivity, and a proliferative index supporting breast origin. Breast imaging identified a 60×40×35 mm left breast soft tissue mass with infiltrating axillary lymph nodes, confirming the primary tumor site as the breast.
